images.prompt: Create a distinguished literary watercolor and matte gouache frontispiece, wide landscape composition on textured paper. Use reference only for the identity of the short-haired, short-bearded protagonist. Northern Iberia rocky open oak woodland, autumn 40,000 BP. Night in muted silver, slate blue, ochre, large quiet areas of painterly color, graphite detail selective. The mood is weary appraisal and uncertainty. A SINGLE barefoot lean ordinary man stands in clear three-quarter PROFILE, two legs and two arms. CLEAN NATURAL SKIN: NO tattoos, no drawings, symbols, scars or ornamental skin marks. Rough bark waist panels, bare head and front torso. A small narrow fox skin strip lies over his anatomical LEFT shoulder and hangs down the front; not a fur coat. His grass back panel is removed and out of view. He looks toward the new bare light framework beside his old leaf and bark lean-to beneath a fallen mossy limb. The old roof is retained on the left; two small fork braces hold a thin rail with only THREE sloping ribs on the new right side. That new side is entirely bare and unfinished, no new covering. A SMALL shallow basket of shelled hazelnut kernels on the ground near his feet, not in his hands. Original plain wooden atlatl and ONE blunt unfletched wooden dart resting on ground, subtle foreground reminders of deferred ambitions. No stone points or attached feathers. Both hands relaxed and visible, pose calm and anatomically simple. A full moon breaks thin cloud in the distance; no indoor fire, no locals, no extra figure, no future equipment. Favor translucent expressive washes and matte blue-gray gouache over photographic detail. No lettering or captions.
